name: Washington Aerial Robotics

name: Washington Disciples For Christ
description: WDFC (Washington Disciples For Christ) is an evangelical, international student mission organization dedicated to continuous witnessing for Christ, building them up, and sending them to all nations to fulfill the Great Commission

name: Washington Gaming Association Fighting Game Club

name: Washington Gaming Association: Valorant
description: A community of UW students who play Valorant, for casual and experienced players alike.

name: Washington Husky STUNT
description: We are a collegiate stunt team that competes against other college teams in a sport rooted in cheerleading, gymnastics, acrobatics, and tumbling.

name: Washington Hyperloop

name: Washington iGEM
description: International Genetically Engineering Machine (iGEM) is the premier international synthetic biology student research competition. Started at MIT in 2004, it now includes over 300 student teams from all over the world.

name: Washington Journal of Law, Technology, and the Arts
description: The Washington Journal of Law, Technology & Arts strives to publish quality legal scholarship at the intersection of law, technology, and the arts.

name: Washington Men's Ultimate Frisbee
description: To promote the sport of Ultimate Frisbee among the UW community.

name: Washington Public Interest Research Group
description: WashPIRG is a a nonpartisan, studentrun organization dedicated to making a difference on issues students care about. We give students the skills and opportunities to mobilize and advocate for social change.  Get involved at washpirgstudents.org!

name: Washington State Pharmacy Association Student Chapter
description: The Washington State Pharmacy Association exists to advocate on behalf of its members to ensure pharmacy professionals are engaged and valued as essential to the healthcare team to optimize patient outcomes.

name: Washington Student Association UW Chapter
description: The Washington Student Association advocates for students in Washington state to the state legislature in Olympia. Some historic victories include the creation of the Washington College Grant, large expansions of voting rights, and tuition freezes.

name: Washington Superbike
description: Washington Superbike is an engineering RSO with the ultimate goal to compete in the MotoStudent competition. We offer opportunities in engineering design, research, manufacturing, business, marketing and personal growth in students.

name: Washington Wave
description: Washington Wave is an organization dedicated to the education and professional development of its members in the renewable energy sector of the Blue Economy within a safe, inclusive and fun environment.

name: Washington Women's Lacrosse Club
description: To participate in the WCLA as a part of NWWLL at a competitive level, while instilling values of good sportsmanship and athleticism and growing the sport of women's lacrosse at UW.

name: Washington Women's Ultimate Frisbee
description: The Washington Women's Ultimate Frisbee team consists of a diverse group of athletes who compete regionally as well as nationally, and compete against local/national teams.

name: Washington Yacht Club
description: Our purpose is to teach and promote sailing among students, staff and alumni of the University of Washington.

name: Wasian Culture Club
description: Our club's main goal is to discuss and explore contemporary Wasian identity in the postmodernist cultural landscape of America. Anyone, regardless of race, is welcome to join.

name: Water and Infrastructure Professionals
description: Water and Infrastructure Professionals (WIPs) is affiliated with local professional organizations related to drinking water, wastewater, & infrastructure. Connect with WIPs to network, learn, and have fun.

name: Wealth Management Association
description: The Wealth Management Association is a student organization dedicated to supporting students interested in careers in the wealth management industry. We focus on financial advisory, tax planning, and estate planning, providing members with opportunities.

name: Web Impact at University of Washington
description: Web Impact is a web development RSO that creates websites for local organizations. We provide web development workshops and connect members to local website projects.

name: WEGET Magazine
description: WEGET Magazine is a studentrun media company initiated to share interpretations of arts, culture, and lifestyle through paper magazines.

name: Wellness and Resilience at the University of Washington
description: Applying concepts from the EDUC Wellness and Social and Emotional Learning courses, WandR seeks to cultivate an inclusive community of students looking to continue the practice of mental health/wellbeing through a preventative, skillbased lens.

name: Wellness with Latinas
description: promote and bring wellness to the University of Washington Latina community campus. At the same time, bringing awareness to the struggles of mental health and being faced with generational trauma.

name: Wesley Club
description: Wesley Club is an open, inclusive LGBTQ+ affirming Methodist campus ministry. We provide a space where everyone is welcome to come connect and be in community, explore faith in their own way, and pursue justice. Come join our table; you are welcome here!

name: West African Student Association
description: Our purpose is to promote the development of leadership skills, provide key resources and campus support for academics, professional development and internship opportunities, and most important of all build a community within the West African Community.

name: West Africans @UW
description: WA@UW is the home for West African culture at the University of Washington. We celebrate our roots through music, food, fashion, and community. Whether you're West African or just vibing with the culture—come join the movement. We bring the WOW to UW.

name: WGA Magic: The Gathering
description: Our purpose is to build a community of Magic: The Gathering players at UW and to run weekly events encompassing a variety of different formats. Join the discord to learn more about how to get involved here https://discord.gg/Mfmg84f

name: WGA Overwatch
description: To provide a competitive and recreational home for fans of the video game Overwatch by Blizzard Entertainment.

name: WiCyS UW Chapter
description: Women in Cybersecurity (WiCyS) is a national organization consisting of student chapters, professional committees, and an annual conference all working towards promoting the recruitment, retention, and advancement of women in cybersecurity.

name: WiUX: Women in User Experience
description: Our mission is to empower and connect women at the University of Washington and aid their endeavors in User Experience and related fields through communitybased events.

name: Women Empowerment through Collaborations, Awareness, and Resources for Education
description: WECARE works to empower women globally through expanding resources for health, education, and more. We aim to create an environment where students from all backgrounds and identities can gain a sense of community together between shared values. Through workshops, outreach, and collaborations with community partners, we aim to close knowledge gaps and reduce stigma surrounding topics that are often overlooked in traditional education. We understand that education is empowerment. WECARE is one of the founding RSOs of the Pregnancy Test Access Project, bringing free pregnancy tests to UW's campus

name: Women in Chemical Engineering at the University of Washington
description: The primary purpose of this organization is to educate, empower, and advocate for women in chemical engineering, and their supporters, by providing an open space for dialogue, mentorship, collaboration, camaraderie, and skill building.

name: Women in Computing
description: Women in Computing (WiC) at the University of Washington is a group of students in the Paul G. Allen School (of all genders and orientations) dedicated to cultivating a strong supportive community of women in the Allen School.

name: Women in Consulting at Washington
description: Women in Consulting at Washington (WICW) is the premier consulting organization for undergraduate women at UW. Founded in 2025, WICW provides a space for women to explore consulting, develop professional skills, and connect with mentors.

name: Women in Informatics
description: WINFO is dedicated to uplifting women and underrepresented voices in technology. We believe that diversity drives innovation, and that every student deserves the tools, community, and confidence to shape the future of technology. We welcome all majors, genders, and identities united by a shared passion for creating a more equitable tech industry.

name: Women in Law Society
description: The Women in Law Society at the University of Washington aims to empower prelaw female/femaleidentifying undergraduate students with support and social mobility as they advance in the legal profession.

name: Women in Orthopaedics Interest Group
description: Women in Orthopaedics Interest Group is a medical studentrun organization that is focused on promoting professional development of University of Washington medical students identifying as female of all backgrounds to succeed in orthopaedic surgery.

name: Women of Aerospace
description: Women in Aerospace is a group devoted to promoting women and minority workplace rights, helping engineering students succeed, and participating in aero outreach to encourage young women and other underrepresented groups to consider engineering careers.

name: Women's Club Baseball at The University of Washington
description: The Women's Club Baseball team at the University of Washington is committed to creating more opportunities for women to play baseball at a higher level. We are working with the Baseball For All Foundation to create a more inclusive future of baseball.

name: Women's Club Soccer at UW
description: We play competitive soccer against club teams from other colleges on the west coast (Washington, Oregon, Idaho, California). We have 2 practices a week, a fall league, and 2+ tournaments a year.

name: Women's Club Volleyball at UW
description: The club's purpose is to come together and play volleyball at a more competitive level than Intramural sports.

name: Women's Field Hockey at the University of Washington
description: Women's Field Hockey at the University of Washington aims to provide a relaxed and collaborative environment in which women can hone their athletic field hockey skills, create friendships, and build character in and out of practice.

name: Women's Health Advocacy Team at UW
description: Women’s Health Advocacy Team at UW is dedicated to empowering individuals through education, awareness, and support regarding health issues that primarily affect women.

name: Women's Ice Hockey Club UW Chapter
description: Our purpose is to provide a competitive and fun environment for women who wish to play the sport of ice hockey.

name: Women's Law Caucus
description: The Women's Law Caucus is a feminist organization committed to facilitating the interaction of women in the law school for mutual enjoyment, support, and encouragement, both among themselves and with women who are practicing law in the community.

name: Women's Rugby at UW
description: It shall be the purpose of this organization to play and promote the game of rugby.

name: Women's Run Club @UW
description: The Women's Run Club @UW empowers women of all backgrounds and abilities to connect through running. We foster a welcoming, supportive community that encourages fitness, friendship, and personal growth.

name: Women's Water Polo Club at University of Washington
description: Organize a team of women interested in learning, playing and competing in water polo.

name: Womens Basketball Club
description: The Women's basketball club is a safe space that provides students for the opportunity to play basketball recreationally with others who share the same love for the sport.

name: Woof3D
description: As the 3D printing club at UW, we provide a hub for anyone interested in 3D printing. Whether you're a beginner or an expert, we have something for everyone. Experience is not required, and neither is any time commitment. During Fall Quarter, we hold weekly workshops mostly aimed towards beginners. These will teach the basics of 3D modeling in OnShape, as well as how to print using the club printers. We also provide members with the opportunity to work on a larger scale 3D printing project with other members throughout the year. Joining a team is not required, but it is a good way to get hands

name: Writers in Progress
description: Interested in creative writing? We create a positive, casual space where people interested in a variety of forms of creative writing can meet and provide each other with support and feedback. Bring something to share or just come to chat! :)

name: xpress Dance Crew
description: Tightknit dance community for dancers of all levels to learn and improve in dance through unique opportunities to choreograph, perform, and simply jam out!

name: Yarn It at UW
description: Yarn It is a group dedicated to teaching other UW students how to relax through the art of crochet! From beginner to expert we meet weekly to share our love of yarn.

name: Yarn With a Purpose at UW
description: We are a student run organization that knit/crochet for those in need. We donate everything created by our members to homeless shelters, womens shelters, hospitals, and more! No experience is necessary and all patterns used are beginner friendly.

name: Young Americans for Liberty at UW
description: We are Young Americans for Liberty (YAL) at the University of Washington. Our group is dedicated to advancing individual liberties, freedom from government oppression, peace, and free markets. YAL at UW seeks to educate the youth about the philosophy of liberty, property, capitalism, economics, and the dangers of war. Get involved with us today!

name: Young Democratic Socialists of America at UW
description: We are the Young Democratic Socialists of America chapter at the University of Washington, Seattle. We are a leftist student group seeking to spread the tenets of democratic socialism on campus through activism, education and campus outreach.

name: Young Democrats at UW
description: Young Democrats is the leftofcenter umbrella group for students on the UW campus seeking to promote youth involvement in progressive politics! We volunteer at the national, state, and local levels with campaigns and on advocacy issues locally :)

name: Young Life College
description: Our purpose is to provide a place where students can come and enjoy fellowship in a safe welcoming community while learning what it means to live out our faith while enjoying college.

name: YUVAraga

name: Zaytoon at the University of Washington

name: Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Incorporated Kappa Nu Chapter
description: To foster the ideals of service, charity, scholarship, civic and cultural endeavors, sisterhood, and finer womanhood.

name: Zeta Tau Alpha
description: We are an organization that strives to promote community service, sisterhood, and education. These things allow us to create well rounded members that can positively affect the UW community at large and their various other communities.
